extraction.method: transcription from the official PDF text layer, checked against 140 dpi page renders

notes: If a candidate answers a question TWICE, only mark the FIRST attempt. If a candidate has crossed out an attempt of a question and not redone the question, mark the crossed out version. Consistent accuracy applies in ALL aspects of the marking memorandum. Stop marking at the second calculation error. Assuming answers/values in order to solve a problem is NOT acceptable. A mark for a correct statement (a statement mark is independent of a reason) is indicated by S. A mark for the correct reason (a reason mark may only be awarded if the statement is correct) is indicated by R. Award a mark if statement AND reason are both correct (S/R).

parts.working_md:
$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{\cos x+\sin x}{\cos x-\sin x}-\dfrac{\cos x-\sin x}{\cos x+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{(\cos x+\sin x)^2-(\cos x-\sin x)^2}{(\cos x-\sin x)(\cos x+\sin x)}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^2 x+2\sin x\cos x+\sin^2 x-(\cos^2 x-2\sin x\cos x+\sin^2 x)}{\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{2(2\sin x\cos x)}{\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x}=\dfrac{2\sin 2x}{\cos 2x}=2\tan 2x=\mathrm{RHS}$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{(\cos x+\sin x)^2-(\cos x-\sin x)^2}{(\cos x-\sin x)(\cos x+\sin x)}$

$=\dfrac{(\cos x+\sin x+\cos x-\sin x)(\cos x+\sin x-\cos x+\sin x)}{\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{(2\cos x)(2\sin x)}{\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x}=\dfrac{2(2\sin x\cos x)}{\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x}=\dfrac{2\sin 2x}{\cos 2x}=2\tan 2x$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\mathrm{RHS}=2\tan 2x=\dfrac{2\sin 2x}{\cos 2x}=\dfrac{2(2\sin x\cos x)}{\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x}=\dfrac{4\sin x\cos x}{\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{1+2\sin x\cos x-(1-2\sin x\cos x)}{\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{(\cos x+\sin x)^2-(\cos x-\sin x)^2}{(\cos x+\sin x)(\cos x-\sin x)}$

$=\dfrac{\cos x+\sin x}{\cos x-\sin x}-\dfrac{\cos x-\sin x}{\cos x+\sin x}=\mathrm{LHS}$
